title: Trialmaster Boss Guide: Escalating Waves, Arena Hazards and Rewards
summary: Complete Trial of the Sekhemas final boss guide for the Trialmaster covering escalating wave mechanics, arena hazards, phase transitions and unique reward table.
description: Learn how to beat the Trialmaster in Path of Exile 2 Trial of the Sekhemas with wave management, hazard avoidance, community evidence and rewards.
location: Trial of the Sekhemas, Final Chamber
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team
imageAlt: The Trialmaster commanding waves of constructs from a raised platform

sections.title: Remember These Three Things First
sections.callout: Clear each wave completely before the Trialmaster becomes vulnerable — do not ignore adds.
calloutDetail: The Trialmaster is invulnerable during active waves. Only after all constructs in a wave are destroyed does he take damage for 8 seconds.
Each wave adds a new arena hazard. By Wave 3, you face spinning blades, poison clouds and fire jets simultaneously.

answers.label: Hardest phase
answers.text: Wave 3 — triple hazard overlap with elite constructs

answers.label: Key stat
answers.text: AoE clear speed — waves must die within 20 seconds or hazards stack

steps.label: Complete preceding Trial chambers
body: The Trialmaster is the final encounter in the Trial of the Sekhemas. You must clear all preceding chambers including the Arbiter of Divinity.

steps.label: Enter the Final Chamber
body: The Final Chamber is a large rectangular arena with hazard mechanisms built into the floor and walls. The Trialmaster stands on a raised platform at the far end.

steps.label: Activate the encounter
body: Step onto the central platform to begin. The Trialmaster summons the first wave immediately.

facts.label: Arena layout
facts.note: Spinning blades, poison vents, fire jets

facts.label: Attempt cost
facts.note: No additional cost after preceding chambers

items.label: High AoE clear speed
checks: Verify you can clear 6 constructs in under 15 seconds.
items.why: Waves must die quickly; each surviving construct adds hazard uptime.
items.fix: Bring your highest AoE skill setup; single-target is secondary.

items.label: Chaos and fire resistance 75%
checks: Verify both chaos and fire resistance are capped.
items.why: Poison clouds deal chaos damage; fire jets deal fire damage. Both are unavoidable hazards.
items.fix: Use Topaz and Ruby flasks; craft chaos suffixes on armour.

items.label: High movement speed (40%+)
items.why: Spinning blades require constant repositioning; slow characters get cornered.
items.fix: Movement speed boots, Tailwind support, or Dash skill.

items.label: Sustained DPS for vulnerability windows
checks: Verify you can deal 2M+ damage in an 8-second window.
items.why: The Trialmaster is only vulnerable for 8 seconds between waves. Maximise this window.
items.fix: Save burst cooldowns for vulnerability windows; do not waste them on constructs.

phases.label: Wave 1 — Basic Constructs
objectives: Learn the spinning blade pattern (activates after 10 seconds).
notes: Six constructs spawn: 4 melee (physical slam) and 2 ranged (chaos bolt). Spinning blades activate on the arena edges after 10 seconds.
After all constructs die, the Trialmaster becomes vulnerable for 8 seconds. Burn as much HP as possible.

phases.label: Wave 2 — Elite Constructs and Poison
phases.trigger: Trialmaster HP drops below 66% after a vulnerability window.
objectives: Avoid poison clouds (new hazard from floor vents).
Manage spinning blades plus poison simultaneously.
notes: Eight constructs spawn: 4 melee, 2 ranged, 2 elite (higher HP, slam creates shockwave). Poison vents activate on the floor — green clouds deal chaos damage over time.
Elites must be killed last; they enrage nearby constructs when alive, granting them 30% increased damage.

phases.label: Wave 3 — Triple Hazard and Enrage
phases.trigger: Trialmaster HP drops below 33% after a vulnerability window.
objectives: Kill 10 constructs including 3 elites under triple hazard conditions.
Survive spinning blades + poison clouds + fire jets simultaneously.
Burn the Trialmaster during the final vulnerability window.
notes: Ten constructs spawn with 3 elites. Fire jets activate from the walls, creating horizontal beams at waist height every 6 seconds.
The Trialmaster also casts chaos bolts from his platform during this wave. Dodge laterally.
After all constructs die, the Trialmaster descends from his platform and is vulnerable until killed.

attacks.name: Spinning Blades
telegraph: Blade mechanisms on arena edges glow red 1 second before activating.
responses: Stay in the arena centre. Blades sweep the outer 3 metres in a rotating pattern.
notes: Activate 10 seconds into Wave 1 and remain active for the rest of the fight. Rotation speed increases each wave.
commonMistakes: Fighting constructs near the edge and getting caught by blades.

attacks.name: Poison Vent Clouds
telegraph: Floor vents hiss and emit green smoke 2 seconds before the cloud forms.
responses: Move away from the vent. Clouds are 3m radius and persist for 6 seconds.
notes: Deal chaos damage over time. Standing in a cloud for more than 3 seconds is usually fatal. Multiple clouds can overlap.
commonMistakes: Standing in a cloud to finish killing a construct.

attacks.name: Wall Fire Jets
telegraph: Wall nozzles glow orange 1.5 seconds before firing a horizontal beam.
responses: Dodge-roll through the beam or move perpendicular. The beam is at waist height — jumping does not avoid it.
notes: Fire every 6 seconds from alternating walls. Beam crosses the full arena width. Deals heavy fire damage and applies ignite.
commonMistakes: Trying to jump over the beam instead of rolling through or moving perpendicular.

attacks.name: Trialmaster Chaos Bolt
telegraph: The Trialmaster raises his staff; a purple orb forms in 1 second.
responses: Strafe laterally. The bolt is a slow projectile aimed at your position at cast time.
notes: Fires every 4 seconds during Wave 3. Moderate damage but forces movement that may push you into hazards.
commonMistakes: Ignoring the bolt and getting pushed into poison clouds by the dodge.

sections.title: Build Considerations
paragraphs: The Trialmaster is an AoE clear check. Builds with fast, wide AoE that can clear 10 constructs in under 20 seconds perform best.
Movement speed is critical for hazard avoidance. Builds that sacrifice movement for damage will struggle in Wave 3.
The 8-second vulnerability windows reward burst damage. Builds with high burst cooldowns (rather than sustained DPS) can skip the Trialmaster's HP thresholds faster.
bullets: AoE builds: prioritise clear speed; use single-target only during vulnerability windows.
Melee builds: use whirlwind or cleave for constructs; save burst for the Trialmaster.
Caster builds: use wide-area spells (Firestorm, Ice Nova) for waves; save instant-cast for hazard dodging.
Avoid pure single-target builds; you will time out on Wave 3 construct count.

entries.label: Trialmaster Full Clear — All Three Waves No Death

entries.question: Is Wave 3 actually possible with all three hazards?
summary: Multiple players confirm Wave 3 is clearable but requires near-perfect hazard awareness. The consensus strategy is to kite constructs in a circular path through the arena centre, avoiding edges (blades) and walls (jets).
editorialAnalysis: We confirmed the circular kiting strategy works. The key insight is that poison clouds spawn at fixed vent locations — memorise the four vent positions and path between them.

problems.symptom: I cannot clear constructs fast enough before hazards overwhelm
checks: Verify your AoE clears 6 constructs in under 15 seconds.
Check if you are chasing constructs into hazard zones instead of kiting them to centre.
directAnswer: Pull all constructs to the arena centre using a circular path. Your AoE should hit all of them simultaneously. Never chase a single construct to the edge.

problems.symptom: Elites in Wave 2 and 3 take too long to kill
checks: Confirm you are killing non-elites first to remove the enrage buff.
Check your single-target DPS during vulnerability windows.
directAnswer: Kill all non-elite constructs first. Elites lose their enrage aura when no other constructs are alive, taking 30% more damage. Then focus elites with burst cooldowns.

rewards.label: Trialmaster's Decree
notes: Unique map fragment that upgrades any map to Trial-tier difficulty with bonus rewards. Trial-exclusive.

rewards.label: Construct Core
notes: Unique jewel granting minion damage and construct summoning skill.

rewards.label: Sekhema's Blessing
notes: One-time currency that adds a Trial modifier to any endgame item.
